messages:
alex: FYI escalated ticket from PandoHealth — after scheduled key rotation their EU traffic started seeing intermittent 403s. They rotated the API key via Vault+KMS last night, but some edge nodes still accept the old key while others reject it. Customer hit us at 02:12 UTC.

marta: Can you paste a sample request/response and any tracer IDs?

alex: From their edge logs (redacted):
X-Request-ID: req_8f3b2c
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Edge curl -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Internal service curl -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Looks like a proxy/edge cache divergence rather than decryption error.

devin: Probable culprits: edge auth cache TTL or sidecar refresh window. Also check for trailing-newline/helm-shadowing in the rotated secret. Reminds me of the trailing newline bug we saw last quarter.

alex: Repro on staging quickly:
1) export API_KEY=oldkey
2) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' https://edge.staging.redwood.example/health -i
-> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Rotate secret in Vault (write new value)
Wait ~10s
curl again -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Edge log snippet: "[edge-auth] cache hit for key=sha256:abc123 ttl=85s source=memory"

marta: Check edge cache TTL and whether the proxy respects an explicit invalidation call. Also verify CDN/cache-control headers from the fronting CDN.

devin: If the auth layer caches the key hash, rotation won't take effect until TTL expires or cache is purged. Two quick fixes: a) force cache invalidation on rotation, b) coordinate a rolling restart of affected edge nodes to flush in-memory caches. Long-term: wire Vault write events to an invalidation hook.

sam: @alex can you run the internal propagation check for that tenant and attach the Vault audit entry for the write? There should be a timestamp we can correlate.

alex: Ran propagation-check: 2/8 EU edge nodes still had the old key in memory. Vault audit shows write at 02:07:14 UTC. Sidecar logs: "refreshed secrets" at 02:07:15 on most pods, but edge-node-03 last secret refresh was 01:59:30 — it missed the watch due to sidecar backoff. Looks like a race with the sidecar refresh/backoff config.

ops-bot: Scheduled: rolling-restart pandohealth/eu-edge-nodes (4 pods) at 03:10 UTC to force cache eviction. :gear:

marta: For next steps we should: add a Vault-to-edge invalidation webhook, add an SLI for rotation-to-invalidation latency, and add a test that simulates staggered sidecar refresh to catch this.

devin: Also add a guard in the rotation script to validate KMS key id and to verify that the new secret decodes correctly before writing (prevents partial-write states). Add CI test in infra repo.

alex: I'll reply to PandoHealth with the restart plan and ask them to provide the edge request-ids if they still see 403s after the restart. If restart doesn't fix, we will escalate to a short maintenance window to roll all EU edge nodes. Will post follow-up here.

sam: Thanks team — please update this thread after the restart. :thumbsup:
